create.name: Donna Shaw
create.bio:
Donna Shaw is a certified Quantum-Touch practitioner and intuitive energy guide who lives in Bucks County, Pennsylvania. She traces her route into the work to a single energy-clearing session some years ago, which left her feeling unexpectedly light, and to the years when her five children grew up and left home, a change that set her asking what came next and led her to take up energy healing as her calling.

Her work is aimed chiefly at women going through a big change in life, such as an empty nest, the end of a marriage, bereavement or a new career. Alongside Quantum-Touch she draws on energy clearing, Court of Atonement processes, intention work and intuitive guidance, and she puts weight on teaching clients to tend their own energy. Private sessions run for an hour over Zoom; shorter remote Quantum-Touch sessions and a weekly group Quantum-Touch circle are also offered, as is THRIVE, a weekly online membership with a library of short recordings set to crystal singing bowls. Closer to home she brings crystal-bowl sound journeys to groups in their own homes or venues around Bucks County and leads a monthly public sound session in Doylestown.

courses.title: Private energy healing sessions
courses.description: One-hour sessions on Zoom in which Donna works with your energy field to clear what is keeping you stuck and to align with what you want to create. Available singly or as a package of three, spaced at least a week apart.

courses.title: Quantum-Touch sessions and community
courses.description: Remote Quantum-Touch: a 20-minute one-to-one session by Zoom or phone, or a place in her weekly group circle on Wednesday afternoons, where you set an intention and rest while she runs life-force energy.

courses.title: THRIVE weekly membership
courses.description: A live online group call every Wednesday for clearing, intention setting and reconnecting with yourself, with every session recorded. Members also get a library of short energy recordings set to crystal singing bowls.

courses.title: Crystal bowl sound journeys
courses.description: Group sound sessions with crystal singing bowls, held at the host's home or venue around Bucks County for 30 or 60 minutes, guided by her intuitive reading of the group. She also leads a monthly public session in Doylestown.

courses.title: Recorded group sessions
courses.description: Recordings of her past group energy sessions, sold for instant access, on themes such as gratitude, attitudes and the choices we make.
